title: MUME Dating Indicators
description: A running chronology of the clues used to date MUME logs and reconstruct when characters, items and NPCs existed.
policy: Approximate dates are sorting anchors, not hard cutoffs. Stronger independent evidence can move an anchor earlier or later. Unresolved clues stay visible.

indicators.title: Guardian-shadow disappearance variants
indicators.summary: A shadow disappears, fades or dissolves during the observed sequence.
indicators.notes: Disappearance without visible owner recovery is a candidate behavioural discriminator. Timeout, killing, omitted lines and client suppression must be distinguished before assigning a historical mechanic.

indicators.summary: A confirmed trophy display uses number killed, knowledge percentage and mobile/player labels.
indicators.notes: This is a dated display-schema attestation, not the introduction of trophies. A leading # outside a trophy display is insufficient evidence.

indicators.title: Calendar output names the Tan Istar
indicators.summary: The time response names a character as the current Tan Istar.
indicators.notes: The office-holder, Arda date and real-time output should be linked. A named tenure can date a log once its independent chronology is established; clock years alone can cross calendar resets.

attestations.quote: The present Tan Istar, Lord of the Istari Council is Morceleb.
The present Tan Istar, Lord of the Istari Council is Dorn.

indicators.title: Early calendar reset / epoch hypothesis
indicators.summary: Some early log dates may belong to an earlier Arda calendar epoch.
indicators.notes: The retained Lady Luck comparison suggests an earlier epoch near the beginning of 1995, but its dating is provisional and partly dependent on map and character chronology. Do not hard-code a reset date from this hypothesis.

attestations.quote: 11pm on Trewsday, the 13th of Winterfilth, Year 3048[1] of the Third Age.

indicators.title: Earlier West Warrens map
indicators.summary: A log’s compatible room topology may identify an older Warrens configuration.
indicators.notes: Repeated room titles and partial paths do not by themselves prove different maps. Relocation boundaries need independent evidence. The current research has an unresolved regional chronology.
